main_town.name: Main Town
main_town.description: The starting town. No monsters — a safe place to get your bearings before heading out.

barren_grasslands.name: The Barren Grasslands
barren_grasslands.description: Open, windswept fields just past the town gates. Gentle creatures, easy footing.

wastelands.name: The Wastelands
wastelands.description: Cracked earth and scrub past the grasslands. Tougher wildlife roams here.

thistlevane_hollow.name: Thistlevane Hollow
thistlevane_hollow.description: A shaded, overgrown hollow — the land's namesake. Thorned and watchful inhabitants.

frostvane_peaks.name: Frostvane Peaks
frostvane_peaks.description: Icy high ground at the edge of the map. The coldest, most dangerous creatures live here.

meadow.name: Thistlevane Meadow
meadow.description: A small, flower-strewn meadow. Quiet, and close to town.
